# Sweep Tools for Alibre Design

- Sweep Tools is an Alibre Design add-on that turns a sketch path into a solid or hollow swept part, so you can make pipes, tubes, and profiled members without building the profile by hand.
  - What it does
    - Creates a swept solid from any 2D or 3D path sketch in the part you have open.
    - Lets you pick a circular or rectangular cross-section and set its size.
    - Makes a hollow tube or pipe when you give it a wall thickness.
    - Works in millimetres, inches, or centimetres.
    - Lets you pick the path sketch from a live list of sketches in the workspace.
    - Cleans up the plane and sketch it created if the sweep fails.
    - Stays open after a sweep so you can create several in a row.
  - What you need
    - Alibre Design with the AlibreScript add-on installed.
    - The .NET Framework 4.8.1 runtime.
    - Visual Studio or MSBuild if you want to build it yourself.
  - Getting started
    - Build `source/SweepTools/src/SweepTools.sln` in Release configuration.
    - Copy the build output into a folder under your Alibre Design add-ons directory.
    - Start Alibre Design, and the add-on loads itself.
    - Open a part, draw the sketch you want to sweep along, then choose Sweep Tools and Advanced Sweep Tool.
    - Pick your path sketch, choose the profile and size, and run the tool.
  - Where things live
    - `source/` holds the VB.NET add-on, the IronPython dialog scripts, and a standalone `PipeTool.py` version you can run from Alibre Script.
    - `documentation/` holds the changelog and reference notes.
    - `submodules/` holds the Alibre Script ADK.
  - Good to know
    - The scripts run under IronPython 2.7, so keep them compatible with Python 2.7.
    - The project file points at an Alibre install path, so adjust it if your version or install folder differs.
  - Use it under the MIT License.
